name: govgate
description: Government-quarter security checkpoint at The Steps (the NW North City enclave's front gate). Entering the `flags.gov_checkpoint` tile from outside the `flags.gov_enclave` quarter hard-blocks wanted players and runs a contraband scan (Deception check → `contraband_possession` bust on fail). The Under tunnel is deliberately left unguarded as the covert bypass. No verbs — a `registerMoveGate` law.
